title: Clear a jammed robot screw feeder
candidate: SR-040 adapted to documented actual recovery
justification: Original Ohtake NSRI robotic assembly feeder with manufacturer-documented abnormal rail-screw recovery.
fault: Abnormal headed screw obstructs the rail beneath the holding plate.
instruction: Restore reliable screw presentation at the robotic feeder pickup.
objects: 123x181x145mm 3kg NSRI-30 screw feeder with original cover, rail, rotary escapement, holding plate and two attaching screws
skill: Clear real trapped screw and restore holding-plate clearance and clamping, with actual feed function restored.
scoring: Development diagnostic scores zero. Final score must require physical unobstructed feed/escaper function with original guide retained after release.

nearest.finding: Read actual source/task text: hold spring pusher back and load cartons behind old stock. Feeder recovery must demonstrate actual captive jam removal and guide restoration; inventory order alone is not novel.
Generic2stop chute dispensing failed jobs relevance. Use actual robotic hardware with real service mechanism, not blocks and stopping rule.
Ratchet cartridge reload with real pawl and rod; generic servicing label alone is insufficient. Proposed fine clearance restoration and jammed headed screw differ if truly physical.

risks: Original plate and screw-tool access against full native gripper and intact case.
Real contact jam: no pose locks, success flags, forced disassembly, or arbitrary friction to trap the screw.
Native screw fastening and friction clamp retain plate after tool release.
Actual restored feed/escaper function, not a gate-open-only partial task.
Native full-scale torque/contact, source-backed spring/actuator estimates and disclosed assumptions.
Final comparison with popular benchmarks and live held tasks before promotion.
Plate subgeometry and fastener M3 size are disclosed photo reconstructions, not OEM detailed dimensions.
Thread clamp preload and vibration drive require defensible estimates and actual native contact; no pose-triggered locking.
valid_shortcuts: Direct clearing with the supplied hex key or hand if it physically works.
Backing out or removing original plate; no invented mandatory two-arm rule.
Harmless reorientation/stock removal if original hardware permits; final correct function still required.

sources.supports: p9holding plate clearance0..1mm and two attaching screws; p26remove abnormal rail screw by moving bracket up then readjust; p31actual123x181x145mm3kg, level bench, supplied hex wrench. Manufacturer labels product robotic.
Read-only dimensional/access reference; no license to redistribute OEM CAD assumed.

Alternative real feeder:215x454x323mm17kg, documented screw gate/descent-hole jams and0.3..0.5mmhead clearance. More complex compressed-air escapement; not selected merely to avoid smaller real hardware.

strict_review: Conditional buildworthiness about0.20 only if original jam, clamp, and restored operation are physical. Generic opening/pickup or stocked dispensing alone would fail. No final novelty clearance.
source_correction: Manufacturer STEP/DXF provides2.6mmshaft4.5mmhead, original washer stack, fixed slotted outer bracket and moving threaded1.2mm L-plate. EarlierM3/front-facing model superseded.
